Hi to desk team,
Feeding routines came up last week, so just a quick note that we should keep our advice steady and calm when pet owners ask how to plan the trip. The main goal is to make the handoff easy for them and keep the animal comfortable, whether the traveler is preparing at home or checking in at the airport. When we talk through the basics, please keep the tone warm, practical, and reassuring, since a clear explanation goes a long way.

For reptile cases, <<FACT F078>> and we should make sure that line is included cleanly whenever it applies. Beyond that, keep reminding customers that they will get clear guidance before departure, and that they can bring up concerns without feeling rushed. If someone is nervous about a pet's feeding or handling routine, answer in plain language and keep the focus on what helps the animal stay settled. That approach reflects how we want the Companion Animal Travel Desk to sound across every contact.

Aurelia Skyways has been getting good feedback when we stay consistent on the small details, so let's keep doing that. If a file needs a closer look, pass it along early rather than waiting, and keep notes tidy so the next person can pick it up smoothly. Thanks for staying patient, helpful, and steady with every traveler who reaches out. Companion Animal Travel Desk
